cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Lake George, NY for Thanksgiving week, November 26–28, 2026, for a group of six adults.

specialist.summary: A three-day Thanksgiving week itinerary for six adults at Lake George, NY featuring steamboat cruises, kayaking, whitewater rafting, mini-golf, and lakeside dining at Italian and hibachi restaurants.

stops.title: Lake George Steamboat Company Cruise
stops.description: Founded in 1817 as a commercial shipper, the Lake George Steamboat Company now offers authentic passenger vessel cruises up and down the lake. The company is considered by locals to be Lake George's "claim to fame" and is always a tourist attraction. Adult tickets range from $17–57. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Lake George Kayak Company
stops.description: Get out on the lake with kayaking. Watch out for wind direction as it can significantly impact paddling time and difficulty to return to shore. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Mario's Restaurant
stops.description: Italian restaurant serving since 1954 with a full-service bar. Dinner is offered Monday–Thursday from 4:30 PM and Sunday from 3 PM. Reservations are advised as the restaurant is popular. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Wild Water's Outdoor Center Rafting
stops.description: Family-owned and operated since 1984, this outfitter offers rafting trips on the Hudson and Sacandaga rivers with equipment, meals, and experienced guides included. Hours 8 AM–6 PM. Listed price $19–$90. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Pirate's Cove Adventure Golf
stops.description: Mini-golf with nice greens and newer obstacles; more upscale than the other local option. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Sushi Yoshi
stops.description: Hibachi steakhouse serving Chinese and Japanese food. Features authentic low tables situated over hollow pits for Japanese izakaya-style dining. Lunch and dinner seven days a week. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Gooney Golf
stops.description: Classic old-fashioned mini-golf with windmill-type obstacles. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Nina's Sweet Shop
stops.description: Local favorite offering a variety of sweets including fudge, taffy ice cream, and sugar-free options. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: The Rooftop Cabana Bar
stops.description: Outdoor dining on the shore of Lake George with panoramic views from Surfside on the Lake's rooftop terrace. Menu includes appetizers, salads, sandwiches, paninis, burgers, and steak. Hours Noon–8 PM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Savannah, GA, April 9–11, 2027, for two adults who like history and food.

specialist.summary: This three-day itinerary blends Savannah's rich history and celebrated food culture, from cemetery walks and historic plantations to innovative Italian dining and cherished local restaurants.

stops.title: Gallery Espresso
stops.description: Start your day with coffee, tea, sweets and sandwiches while enjoying outside seating on Chippewa Square surrounded by local art. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Wormsloe Historic Site
stops.description: Explore the entrance lined with a beautiful avenue of live oak trees and visit the visitor center to learn the history of the plantation. Trails along the marshes offer more historical context. Admission $10. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: Forsyth Park
stops.description: Walk through this large public park that marks the southern edge of the Historic District, crowned with a beautiful fountain and ringed with historic architecture. This is the iconic filming location from Midnight in the Garden of Good & Evil, known for its romantic Spanish moss-draped setting. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: Saint Bibiana
stops.description: Dine at a fine Italian cuisine restaurant and cocktail lounge in the historic Savannah Bardo Hotel. The restaurant features chic artwork, stunning chandeliering, and the full restoration of the original 1888 Savannah Mansion. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: The Collins Quarter at Forsyth
stops.description: Enjoy a great brunch menu and atmosphere at the only restaurant inside Forsyth Park. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Georgia State Railroad Museum
stops.description: Visit a museum featuring several vintage pieces of rolling stock, an operating model train layout, and an operating turntable. Open daily 9AM-5PM. Adults $7.70. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: City Market
stops.description: Explore this mixed-use project in the northwest corner of the Historic District. The four-block area was rehabilitated beginning in 1985 and has become an established destination with shops and dining. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: B. Matthew's Eatery
stops.description: Enjoy dinner at this downtown restaurant at 325 East Bay Street, ideally positioned to explore River Street or end your day near the water. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: River Street
stops.description: Stroll the popular cobblestone street along the south bank of the Savannah River, lined with numerous shops and restaurants. Visit the sculpture of the Waving Girl towards the east end. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: Plant Riverside District
stops.description: Tour the redeveloped former power plant opened in 2020. The J. W. Marriott hotel anchors the development with Generator Hall—a publicly-accessible lobby featuring shops, restaurants, and a large collection of minerals and geodes. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: Bonaventure Cemetery
stops.description: Visit this atmospheric cemetery known for Johnny Mercer's grave and those of other Southern notables including Conrad Aiken. The view of the river is wonderful, and the Spanish moss creates a spooky, historically rich atmosphere. (Confirm it's open on your dates.)

stops.title: B&D Burgers
stops.description: End your trip with excellent burgers at this local chain with multiple downtown locations off of Ellis Sq or further west on Broughton. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

cases.task: Build a two-day itinerary for Harpers Ferry, WV, November 14–15, 2026, for two adults.

specialist.summary: A two-day historical tour of Harpers Ferry focusing on Civil War sites, including the Visitor Center, Lower Town historic district, John Brown's Fort, scenic river views at The Point, and Bolivar Heights battlefield.

stops.title: Visitor Center orientation and shuttle to Lower Town
stops.description: Start with an orientation at the Visitor Center, then take the shuttle down to Lower Town to get your bearings and learn about the site's significance as a crossroads of history.

stops.title: Lower Town historic district and John Brown's Fort
stops.description: Explore the preserved historic buildings and structures in Lower Town, including John Brown's Fort, a key site associated with the 1859 raid and the lead-up to the Civil War.

stops.title: The Point river-confluence viewpoint
stops.description: End the day at The Point, where the Shenandoah and Potomac rivers converge. This scenic overlook offers beautiful views and is particularly rewarding at sunset.

stops.title: Bolivar Heights battlefield walk
stops.description: Begin your second day with a self-guided walk across Bolivar Heights, where you can see the landscape and learn about Civil War-era military positions and the strategies employed during the conflict.

stops.title: Lower Town historic district—deeper exploration
stops.description: Return to Lower Town for a more detailed visit to buildings and exhibits you may have passed on Day 1, allowing more time to absorb the full historical narrative of Harpers Ferry.

stops.description: One of the largest Spanish fortresses in the New World, part of San Juan National Historic Site. The visitor center offers information in English and Spanish. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.description: Explore the historic colonial streets and architecture of Old San Juan, with colorful buildings and cultural landmarks.

stops.title: Condado beach day

activities.title: Cuartel de Ballaja
activities.description: Completed in 1863, and in 1881 a chapel was added. This building housed military personnel and is now a museum called Las Americas Museum containing Caribbean and European American arts and artifacts.
